_doc: Sling Bounce ship-bg-v1: Sunbaked Canyon background drop for Canyon Floor (0-2k) + per-zone wall strips + 7-zone sky table. Files are @2x (engine DPR cap 2x); *_px3 values are @3x master pixels: divide by 1.5 for @2x (ship/ convention). PLACE BY ANCHOR, never by canvas. Copy this folder's contents into src/assets/art/ next to ship/: categories bg/, props/, fx/, walls/ do not collide with ship/ (character/, platforms/, objects/, markers/). ship/ is unchanged by this drop.

scale.masters: @3x masters kept art-side (not in this folder)

coordinates.c: camera climb = camera.y - startHeight (world CSS px above the run start; HUD '2k' = 2000)
coordinates.playfield: camera.width 360..430 CSS. Full-width layers are authored 430 wide: centre them (x0 = (camera.width - 430)/2). Props and walls stay wall-anchored.

z_order._doc: back to front; all background layers draw inside Renderer.drawBackground (before the kill line), so every ship/ sprite draws on top
layers: ship objects/* (bumpers, arrow pads, POW, coins, portals, turrets: portals + turrets overlap the walls)

parallax._doc: screen offset = c * factor (1.0 = moves with the world/platforms)

home_turf.note: Mesa Tops art is not in this drop: above the blend strip the screen is sky + rock walls + dust until Mesa Tops ships.

blend.sky: each of the 3 stops lerps zone N -> N+1 with smoothstep over boundary +-200 climb (Canyon->Mesa: 1800..2200); same rule at every zone boundary
blend.blend_strip: bg/canyon-to-mesa_blend, centre row on world climb 2000 (parallax 1.0); top and bottom rows fully transparent
blend.dust: Canyon Floor + Mesa Tops; fade spawn out over 4500..5000
blend.walls: rock in both zones: no change at 2000

props_scatter.spawn: world-anchored, climb 0..1950, one every 220-380 CSS of climb, alternate sides (30% same side), never repeat the last 2
props_scatter.avoid: skip if within 70 CSS (vertical) of a portal or turret on the same wall
props_scatter.lane: max reach 56 CSS from the wall face (x <= 76): stays in the outer 20%, never the centre 60%

dust.spawn: 70% in the outer lanes (x < 86 or x > camera.width - 86), 30% anywhere at alpha <= 0.3
dust.motion: drift up 6-14 CSS/s + sideways sine +-8 CSS; life 4-7 s with 0.6 s fade in/out; screen-space, offset by c*0.6

walls.engine_note: wall body = x 0..20 CSS of each strip (WALL = 20). The DD-approved inner edge line is centred on x = 20 (inner_edge_x_css) and must sit EXACTLY on the collision edge: Engineering Manager draws the 20-CSS body in a gutter outside the play area, so x = 20 of the strip lands on play x = 0 (left) / play width (right, mirrored). Only the pillar / cloud bumps cross that line into the play area, by max_intrusion_css <= 4 CSS (DD 2026-10-02); the straight ink lines cross by half their 2 px width. Canvas stays 30 CSS (art never reaches past x = 24, so nothing is clipped).

walls/night-rim/wall_night_tile.what: 2 CSS cream rim @70% outside the night wall's ink line (DD-approved rim)

walls/wall_cloud_tile.what: cloud puffs (squashed) + half the 2px ink line

walls/wall_night_tile.what: 2px ink line @60% centred on the edge (half its width)

walls/wall_rock_tile.what: 2px ink line @60% centred on the edge (half its width)

walls/wall_storm_tile.what: pillar bumps (squashed) + half the 4px ink outline

walls/wall_strato_tile.what: pillar bumps (squashed) + half the 4px ink outline

alignment.props: props keep anchor x = 4 CSS = the wall face: put that on the same collision edge (left canvas x = playLeft - 4); max reach 47.5 CSS from the edge

walls.orbit: placeholder: Orbit uses wall_night (+ night rim) like the contact sheets; 'station rails' are not designed yet (needs DD).
walls.zone_change: crossfade over 96 CSS of world height centred on the zone boundary: lower kind drawn up to boundary+48, upper kind from boundary-48 with alpha = smoothstep(b-48, b+48, rowClimb).
walls.contrast_ref: art-side step-3 walls contrast table: turret dome, portal pillar and ball vs every wall tone all pass (unchanged tones)

sky_table.gradient: screen-space vertical linear: top at y=0, mid at 0.5*camera.height, bottom at camera.height (kit3.sky3)
sky_table.night: night rims + crumbling-night stone + wall_night rim from Orbit up
sky_table.source: approval kit v3.1 ZONES7 (Canyon Floor stops == the Sunbaked Canyon theme table; Stratosphere = DD re-key)

pop_min.blur_pop_note: wall-mounted turret/portal exempt from blur pop (they sit on the wall; wall contrast = the step-3 walls table, Hi Cream ring >= 4.19:1)

checks.seams: all tile files tiled 3x: wrap seam <= interior row-diff p99, and tile rows 0-7 == the continuous render past the tile end (<= 8/255 premultiplied, sub-pixel AA)

bg/canyon-to-mesa_blend.note: sunlit mesa tops + Mesa-gold haze; top and bottom rows fully transparent
bg/canyon-to-mesa_blend.place: world-anchored marker: centre row (px3 510) at sy = camera.slingshotScreenY - (2000 - c), x0 = (camera.width-430)/2. Draw after the mid tile.

bg/canyon_far-key.note: distant mesas + sun + canyon floor; opaque mesa tints so the sun never shows through; top rows fully transparent
bg/canyon_far-key.place: anchor (px3 645,900 = kill row) at (camera.width/2, camera.killScreenY + c*0.15). alpha = 1 - smoothstep(2000, 2400, c). 420 CSS of floor below the anchor covers the strip under the kill line on screens up to ~1340 CSS tall; top rows are fully transparent (sky shows).

bg/canyon_haze-band.note: horizontal dust haze over the canyon floor; uniform across x (stretch or tile freely)
bg/canyon_haze-band.place: centre row (px3 240) at the far-key anchor row - 30 CSS (moves with the far key, same alpha fade). Uniform across x: stretch or tile.

bg/canyon_mid_tile.note: receding canyon strata buttes on both sides (rock @17%, sand ledge lips, no ink); centre 60% empty
bg/canyon_mid_tile.place: tile vertically: a tile top at screen y = camera.slingshotScreenY + c*0.4 + k*684 (wrap). Centre on the playfield (x0 = (camera.width-430)/2). Clip to rows above camera.killScreenY (the kill rope hides the cut; the far-key floor stays clean below it). alpha = 1 - smoothstep(1700, 2100, c) (fades out under the blend strip; no positional cut).

fx/dust_mote.note: soft sand mote, 3 stepped discs (flat style); tint in code
fx/dust_mote.place: ambient particle, white-on-alpha: tint (multiply) with `tint`, see ambient.dust

fx/dust_wisp.note: drifting dust wisp; tint in code; may stretch x up to 1.5
fx/dust_wisp.place: ambient particle, white-on-alpha: tint (multiply) with `tint`, see ambient.dust

props/canyon_cactus-ledge.note: saguaro on a small ledge; muted sage so it never reads as a moving (green) platform
props/canyon_cactus-ledge.place: anchor x (4 CSS) = the wall face = the collision edge. Gutter layout: left canvas x = playLeft - anchor_x_css, right = mirror, canvas x = playRight + anchor_x_css - css_w (walls drawn inside the screen instead: left canvas x = 20 - anchor_x_css = 16, right = camera.width - 20 + anchor_x_css - css_w). y = sy - anchor_y_css with sy = slingshotScreenY - (propClimb - c).

props/canyon_ledge-a.note: sloping rock lip; top drops 14 CSS outward and has no top highlight stripe, so it never reads as a platform

walls/night-rim/wall_night_tile.note: night rim for wall_night (Orbit + Deep Space): cream #FFF1D6 @70%, 2 CSS outside the inner edge; draw first, same tiling phase, offset (-6,0)px3 / (-4,0)px2
walls/night-rim/wall_night_tile.intrusion_is: 2 CSS cream rim @70% outside the night wall's ink line (DD-approved rim)
walls/night-rim/wall_night_tile.place: Orbit + Deep Space only: draw first, same tiling phase as walls/wall_night_tile, canvas x offset -2 CSS from the wall (px3 -6, px2 -4), i.e. its inner_edge_x_css (22) on the same collision edge; mirror on the right like the wall.

walls/wall_cloud_tile.note: Cloud Kingdom: cloud pillar #F6FAFE / shade #DCEAF6, inner edge 2px ink @60% (kit3.cloud_pillar); wall body x 0..20 CSS, canvas 30 so the inner-edge line / pillar scallop bulge (visual only) is never clipped
walls/wall_cloud_tile.intrusion_is: cloud puffs (squashed) + half the 2px ink line
walls/wall_cloud_tile.place: align by inner_edge_x_css (20): that x of the strip goes ON the collision edge. Gutter layout (body outside the play area): left canvas x = playLeft - 20, right = horizontal mirror, canvas x = playRight + 20 - css_w. Only the pillar / cloud bumps cross into the play area, by max_intrusion_css (<= 4). World-anchored vertical tiling: a tile top at world height (k+1)*240 => sy = slingshotScreenY - ((k+1)*240 - c). Same phase on both sides.
